items.text: Assign an accountable implementation owner, security reviewer, and operational owner for **Raw Wasm binary decoder and structural validator**; record escalation paths in M50.
items.note: owner/security reviewer/operator are TBD - must be named by the organisation

items.text: Write normative MUST/SHOULD/MUST-NOT requirements and explicit non-goals; distinguish security invariants from implementation preferences.
Define all trust boundaries, untrusted inputs, trusted upstream facts, downstream consumers, attacker capabilities, and fail-closed behavior for malformed or unavailable dependencies.
Define a versioned machine-readable interface/schema for all externally consumed inputs/outputs/configuration; reject unknown or ambiguous fields according to compatibility policy.
Identify every verdict-affecting datum and require an immutable revision, digest, or authenticated identity suitable for M08 attestations and M09 cache keys.
Define maximum sizes/counts/depths/time budgets for attacker-controlled data before implementation, and link enforceable limits to M13 where relevant.
Implement strict magic/version parsing and reject trailing/leading ambiguity before section decoding.
Decode every standard section with canonical unsigned/signed LEB128 handling, overflow checks, truncation checks, and minimal-encoding policy where required.
items.note: width+unused-bit checks; spec permits non-minimal in-width encodings (tested)

items.text: Enforce section ordering, singleton-section uniqueness, custom-section handling, declared payload lengths, and exact payload consumption.
Validate index spaces and cross-section bounds for types, functions, tables, memories, globals, tags, elements, data, imports, and exports.
items.note: tags refused as UNSUPPORTED_PROPOSAL

items.text: Reject integer overflow/underflow in size arithmetic before allocation, slicing, multiplication, or offset addition.
items.note: Python ints do not wrap; every length checked against remaining bytes

items.text: Apply hard ceilings while decoding names, vectors, nested block structure, section counts, and aggregate bytes rather than after parse completion.
Preserve byte offsets and section context for every parsed construct so downstream errors can identify exact evidence locations.
Expose an immutable parsed-module representation that cannot be mutated by policy callers after structural validation.
Define treatment of unknown future sections/opcodes as fail-closed unless explicitly enabled by the pinned specification registry.
Ensure parser state cannot desynchronize after malformed lengths, unterminated LEB128 values, or invalid UTF-8 names.
items.evidence: sub-Readers bounded per section; evidence/fuzz_campaign.json (0 crashes)

items.text: Use immutable/internal typed representations after trust-boundary validation; do not pass raw unvalidated dictionaries/strings deeper into security decisions when a constrained type is possible.
Make error paths explicit and deterministic; convert implementation exceptions into M12 structured failure codes at the component boundary.
Ensure cancellation, deadline, shutdown, and retry behavior cannot convert an indeterminate or partial result into successful validation/admission.
Document concurrency/thread-safety/reentrancy semantics and protect shared mutable state with an architecture that can be race-tested.
items.note: documented; no component-specific race test

items.text: Perform a component-specific threat-model review covering spoofing, tampering, replay, downgrade, confused-deputy behavior, resource exhaustion, cross-tenant leakage, and unsafe recovery paths as applicable.

items.text: Fail closed for unknown versions/features/states, invalid signatures/digests, partial data, stale security state, and dependency ambiguity unless a narrowly documented safe fallback exists.

items.note: Python ints cannot wrap; all sizes checked against remaining bytes before slicing

items.text: Treat ACCEPT and REJECT caching separately; define TTL/retention according to mutation/freshness risks.
Never key by mutable path, URL, filename, tenant-supplied ID, or unverified digest.
Use atomic writes and corruption detection for persistent cache entries.

items.text: Namespace tenant-sensitive entries and prevent cross-tenant side channels from hit/miss timing or metadata leakage.

items.text: Invalidate by revision change through immutable key variation; avoid broad mutable “current” aliases for security decisions.

items.text: Instrument hit/miss/stale/corrupt/evicted outcomes with controlled metric cardinality.

items.text: Use immutable/internal typed representations after trust-boundary validation; do not pass raw unvalidated dictionaries/strings deeper into security decisions when a constrained type is possible.

Ensure cancellation, deadline, shutdown, and retry behavior cannot convert an indeterminate or partial result into successful validation/admission.

items.text: Write normative MUST/SHOULD/MUST-NOT requirements and explicit non-goals; distinguish security invariants from implementation preferences.
